High.title: All extend difference statements are generic rather than evidence-backed meaningful differences
High.affected_scope: Every difference:*:game-extension finding in phase2-capability-comparisons-v3.json and its embedded copies.
High.evidence: All 71 statements use the same form: "Meaningful difference across <games>: each game retains its accepted <capability> rules and parameters behind the shared contract." The statements name neither a differing dimension nor the actual game variants.
High.contract_failure: The evidence does not establish meaningful differences for extend classification and is not developer-usable as a capability boundary.
High.required_remediation: Rewrite every difference statement from its per-game exact excerpts to name the concrete differing dimension and the actual game-specific variants. Add a negative attack that rejects this boilerplate and equivalent generic rules-and-parameters formulations.

High.title: Every boundary effect is a repeated capability-name template
High.affected_scope: Every similarity and difference finding across all 13 capabilities.
High.evidence: There are only 13 unique boundary-effect objects for 87 findings, one per capability. Each substitutes the capability display name into the same three claims: shared core owns the typed invariant and orchestration; game extension owns accepted tuning, rules, and presentation; interface exposes typed inputs and outcomes.
High.representative_semantic_gap: The effect does not state that shared code clamps elapsed time to 50 ms before a tick, which layer owns requestAnimationFrame scheduling and cleanup, or what bounded-delta value the interface passes.
High.contract_failure: The effects satisfy shape and length checks but do not state finding-specific architectural consequences, violating the v5 readability contract.
High.required_remediation: Author a concrete shared-core ownership, game-extension ownership, and interface consequence for each finding. Add attacks for repeated per-capability effects and generic typed-invariant/tuning/typed-outcomes templates.
